generic: Something went wrong on our side. Give it another try.
network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
from: We couldn't find your starting point. Pick one from the suggestions.
to: We couldn't find your destination. Pick one from the suggestions.
same: Start and destination are the same place. Pick a different one.
date: That date doesn't look right. Pick another one.
noTrips: No route found for that time. Try another time or date, or pick a spot closer to a station.
quoteExpired: That price has expired. We've fetched a fresh one, so just confirm again.
userRejected: You declined it in your wallet, so nothing was charged.

chain.InvalidSignature: We couldn't verify the price. Refresh the page and try again.
chain.QuoteExpired: The price expired (prices last 10 min). Tap the button again for a fresh one.
chain.QuoteAlreadyUsed: This booking already went through. Check “My trips”.
chain.NotPassenger: Use the same wallet you asked for the price with.
chain.OperatorInactive: This operator has paused bookings for now.
chain.OperatorNotRegistered: This operator isn't set up to take bookings yet.
chain.NotLegOperator: Only the operator of this service can do that. Connect the operator wallet.
chain.NotTicketHolder: Only the ticket holder can do that.
chain.InvalidStatus: This ticket has already been used, cancelled or refunded.
chain.RefundDeadlinePassed: The refund window for this ticket has closed.
chain.NoShowTooEarly: You can claim a no-show 2 hours after departure.
chain.BadQuote: Something's off with the booking details. Search again.
chain.TicketLocked: A ticket can't be given away after check-in or cancellation.
chain.FaucetCooldown: You've already had test money this hour. Come back a bit later.
chain.ERC20InsufficientBalance: Not enough test money. Tap “Get free test money”.
chain.ERC20InsufficientAllowance: Payment wasn't confirmed yet. Tap the button again.
chain.ZeroAddress: That wallet address isn't valid. Check it and try again.
chain.InsufficientGas: Your wallet needs a little AVAX for network fees. Grab some test AVAX from the Fuji faucet.
chain.WrongNetwork: Your wallet is on a different network. Tap “Switch to Avalanche”.
